Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable mute/micmute LEDs and limit mic boost on HP ZBook

On some HP ZBooks, the audio LEDs can be enabled by
ALC236_FIXUP_HP_MUTE_LED_MICMUTE_VREF. So use it accordingly.
